hypotheses: While the AI writes a study the owner accepted (Markdown, diagrams or video, which takes minutes), the band's studies chip shows a study is being written, and the writing section of the studies class of iaso's pane lists it as a row '… <title> · <step>' with a bar: empty before the AI reports its first step, then filling as it reports them; the row goes when the study is added.
given the owner accepted a study idea and the AI has reported no step yet, when the studies class is next drawn, then its writing section shows '… <title> · starting' and an empty bar

given the AI ran 'iaso study progress <slug> --step "scene 1" --done 3 --total 5', when the studies class is next drawn, then its writing section shows '… <title> · scene 1' with a bar three fifths full and 60%

given a study with clips was added while progress is reported, when the clips render and are checked, then the writing row stays on the new study, and goes when the last clip passes its check or 'iaso study progress <slug> --finish' runs; a study with no clip loses it when added
given a study that is not accepted and not being written, when the AI runs 'iaso study progress' on it, then iaso refuses and writes nothing
